title: TWO SUM: FINAL BOSS
story: You have reached the final algorithm gate. Return the TWO INDEXES that make the target, not the values.
lesson: A dictionary maps a number to the index where you previously saw it. Each new number checks whether its complement is already in the dictionary. Time O(n), space O(n).
objective: Return [earlier_index, current_index] for the unique pair summing to target. Return [] if no pair exists.
hint: Start seen = {}. For each i, n in enumerate(nums), check 'target - n in seen'. Return [seen[target - n], i] if found, then store seen[n] = i.
